title: Keys and Rooms
description:
You have n rooms numbered from 0 to n-1.

Room 0 is unlocked
All other rooms are locked

Each room may contain keys to other rooms.

Rules
When you enter a room, you can collect all keys inside it
A key lets you unlock and enter another room
You can visit rooms in any order as long as you have the key
Task

Return:

true → if you can visit all rooms
false → if some rooms remain locked
Examples

Example 1

[[1],[2],[3],[]]
→ true

Example 2

[[1,3],[3,0,1],[2],[0]]
→ false
Constraints
2 ≤ n ≤ 1000
Total keys ≤ 3000
Keys are valid room numbers
No duplicate keys in a room
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
